author: Nemefish
rules:
Fireworks

Play on
Sudokubank

Sudokupad does not support dynamic clues so only Sudokubank link is available.

• Normal Sudoku rules apply.

• Dynamic Clues:Placing correct digits may reveal additional clues (or hide existing clues)

• German Whisper (green): Adjacent cells along a German Whisper line must differ by at least 5

• Kropki: Cells are separated by a white dot are consecutive.

• Region Sum Lines (blue dotted line): Box borders divide blue lines into segments with the same sum. Different lines may have different sums.

• Renban (pink dashed line): Digits along Renban lines form a set of consecutive digits with no repeats.

• Parity Lines (red): Digits along parity lines alternate odd and even.

• Counting Circles:A digit on a circle indicates the number of circles containing that digit.

Find more of my puzzles on Sudokubank. Ratings and respectful comments are always appreciated.
